tagline: 柯达便携相机，1965 年发布
description: 柯达于1965年推出的便携相机。配备Plastic, single element, meniscus; 1:11/43mm。快门速度mechanical leaf, with speeds of 1/90 sec. and (with flashcube attached) 1/40 sec.。使用126 film cartridge。

specs.快门: mechanical leaf, with speeds of 1/90 sec. and (with flashcube attached) 1/40 sec.
specs.英文简介: Kodak's greatest success in camera history was the Instamatic camera series for its 126 film cartridge.
